topics.title: Who runs Poland's Constitutional Tribunal?
topics.dek: A judge elected by the governing majority declared herself acting head of the Tribunal on 30 October and suspended its president. The President of Poland calls it a coup. The government says it is restoring the rule of law. Both sides say the other is breaking the constitution.
topics.dekIs: Dómari sem þingmeirihlutinn kaus lýsti sig starfandi forseta stjórnlagadómstólsins 30. október og vék forseta hans frá störfum. Forseti Póllands kallar þetta valdarán. Ríkisstjórnin segist vera að endurreisa réttarríkið. Báðar fylkingar segja hina brjóta stjórnarskrána.
